title: Meta rolls out voice mode and expressive avatars in the Muse app, starting in the US, letting users have voice conversations with Muse in real time (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Meta rolls out voice mode and expressive avatars in the Muse app, starting in the US, letting users have voice conversations with Muse in real time — Muse AI agent now has voices and ‘expressive’ avatars that animate while chatting with you. … The feature has been rolled out to me …
contentText:
Jay Peters / The Verge :

Meta rolls out voice mode and expressive avatars in the Muse app, starting in the US, letting users have voice conversations with Muse in real time   —  Muse AI agent now has voices and ‘expressive’ avatars that animate while chatting with you. … The feature has been rolled out to me …
